fieldValues.title: An RFC-mandated schema-mirror property addition belongs in the implementing PR, not deferred to the generic schema-sync PR
fieldValues.summary: Standing policy is that any content diff to crates/srs-schema/schemas/2.0/ is owner-reviewed, never auto-merged (precedent #903/#905/#915/#926) — but that governs the automated, periodic, whole-mirror schema-drift-catchup PRs the 6-hour poll opens. A unit implementing an accepted RFC that itself specifies an exact, minimal schema property (RFC-034s own Schema Changes section, here childContainerIds) cannot be schema-valid or testable without that property existing in the mirror first. srs-rust#970 added the exact RFC-034 property directly in its implementation PR (#974) rather than waiting on the separate schema-sync PR (#968), hand-verified byte-identical against current srs canonical, and regenerated SHA256SUMS via the mandated sha256sum *.json | sort method (never by hand). The PR was labelled gate:owner-merge rather than the issues own auto-merge suggestion, specifically because it carries a schema content diff.
fieldValues.rationale: Blocking implementation on a separate, unrelated, already-open schema-sync PR (here #968, which was also fixing repo-wide Schema Drift CI for unrelated PRs #971/#969/#966) would either stall the RFC-034 unit indefinitely or force a workaround. The safer line: an RFC-mandated schema property, verified byte-identical to canonical srs and regenerated via the sanctioned script method, is Door 1 execution of that RFC and may travel with its own implementing PR — but the PR must still be gate:owner-merge (never auto-merge) purely because it carries a schema diff, regardless of the RFC-execution mode/door otherwise permitting auto-merge. Reopen this only if the owner disagrees with the classification on #974.
